text:
Mira Patel: Quick check — RFC review tomorrow 10am PT. Current authors: Alex / Sarah / Jon / Tyler. Tyler asked to swap with Jon. Can folks confirm swaps + availability? Thinking of bumping the higher-impact RFC first.

Tyler Nguyen: I can swap with Jon, yes. Prefer an earlier slot if possible.

Jon Castillo: OK to take Tyler's later slot. +1 to moving high-impact first.

Sarah Lee: I can present either slot. Pre-read updated: https://docs.internal/rfcs/rfc-142 (summary at the top).

Alex Romero: I'm fine either way. My pre-read includes a 2m demo video.

Mira Patel: Plan proposal: Tyler -> slot 1, Alex -> slot 2, Sarah -> slot 3, Jon -> slot 4. @dev-bot can you update the calendar and reorder the agenda? Also ask authors to add a 1-line TL;DR at the top of their pre-read.

dev-bot: updated calendar event: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123 — agenda reordered per request. Reminder set 1h before.

Tyler Nguyen: added TL;DR to my pre-read: `TL;DR: switch to sharded KV cache reduces P50 latency by ~12%`

Jon Castillo: added a test-matrix section, keeping detailed benchmarks for the meeting. Proposal: timebox each slot to 12m presentation + 3m Q.

Sarah Lee: +1 to the timebox. Can we avoid live demos unless infra is ready? Otherwise include a short recording.

Mira Patel: Agreed — 12m + 3m, no live demos unless <2m. I'll update the agenda and ping authors. @Alex Romero can you confirm your demo is 2m?

Alex Romero: Yep demo is 2m, will note that in pre-read. I can also move if someone needs the spot.

Mira Patel: Final order then Tyler, Alex, Sarah, Jon. Authors: please have TL;DR + 3-bullet context + an explicit 'ask' section in the pre-read by EOD today. Reviewers: skim the pre-reads and post any blocking questions in this thread so authors can address before the meeting. :thumbsup:

Tyler Nguyen: Done — prep doc: https://docs.internal/rfcs/rfc-tyler-123

Sarah Lee: Done. I left one clarifying question on my doc.

Jon Castillo: Note I'm on PTO in the morning but will join around 10:05. If I'm delayed, Alex can field Qs for me.

Mira Patel: Noted. I'll post the final agenda in #eng by 18:00 and update the calendar with the timeboxed slots. Thanks everyone!
